capture.setup: lab PKI generated with OpenSSL 3.5.5 in registry.access.redhat.com/ubi9/ubi@sha256:a729da793c5f57633fc0dfbe99ced541aedde3ea653d5344af5aabb49f5aeb89: root (RSA 4096, SHA-384) -> issuing CA RSA 2048 -> leaf nginx.fxlab.test RSA 2048 (SAN nginx.fxlab.test, www.fxlab.test, 127.0.0.1, 397 days); nginx serves leaf + intermediate (ssl_certificate nginx-chain.crt) on :443, TLSv1.2/1.3
capture.command: certificate.Probe(host 127.0.0.1, port 18543 -> container :443, serverName nginx.fxlab.test) from the OpenMap certificate collector, run by a throwaway lab program; the presented chain (ConnectionState.PeerCertificates DER) PEM-encoded into chain.pem, the negotiated version/cipher and the verification result into handshake.json

files.name: chain.pem
files.description: certificate chain exactly as presented in the handshake (leaf first), PEM of the DER bytes

files.name: handshake.json
files.description: negotiated TLS version, cipher suite, SNI and the Probe verification result against the capture host's system roots

files.name: lab-root-ca.crt
files.description: public certificate of the lab root CA (not presented by the server; the trust anchor for chain verification)
